limit_margin_basis: Enabled 2026-09-13: the reviewed shot drove light shoulder_lift to 773 counts, its exact mechanical stop, at t=1.76 s, which the operator saw as the arm dropping. The planner now keeps this many degrees off each end of travel and solves inside that range. This is a planning margin, not a measurement; firmware limits and the original calibration are unchanged.
range_basis: Operator-supplied replacement min/max dictionaries on 2026-09-17 after the light-arm motor upgrade, followed by wrist-flex minimum 547 and explicit starting goals. Following the 06:50:52 UTC read-only inspection, the operator revised shoulder-lift minimum to 1684 and wrist-flex maximum to 2879. No firmware writes were performed.
goal_basis: Operator-supplied Light_ARM_GOAL_POSITIONS on 2026-09-17. Shot Studio reset and between-shot parking use these exact encoder counts. They are starting targets, not a measured model-zero pose or permission to move.
note: Replacement software ranges and explicit starting goals for the upgraded light arm. Shoulder-lift offset 0.08791208791208792 degrees and wrist-flex offset -45.89010989010989 degrees preserve the existing software model angle at a given raw count across endpoint revisions. This does not establish physical model alignment after encoder realignment. Other axis signs and offsets are retained. The supplied goal pose does not redefine model zero. Original calibration files are unchanged; their saved firmware homing values differ from the read-only 2026-09-17 inspections and have not been rewritten.
midpoint_basis: (range_min + range_max) / 2 remains the servo-degree normalization reference, with zero_offsets_deg preserving model alignment across endpoint revisions. Explicit raw_goal_positions override arithmetic starting midpoints for Shot Studio. The motor diagnostic retains its separate midpoint sweep.

operator_encoder_realignment.note: Operator reports realigning the encoder. A separate read-only inspection at 2026-09-17 06:50:52 UTC found wrist-flex position 2599 and firmware homing offset -989, compared with position 39 and offset 1502 at 06:29:33 UTC. These snapshots confirm changed readings/settings, not physical endpoint or model alignment verification. See the upgrade record.

historical_evidence_before_motor_upgrade.scope: Evidence for the previous motors/calibration; does not verify the upgraded light arm.
